name: The policy, end to end
caption: Each frame becomes one token (sₜ, aₜ₋₁). A causal context Transformer reads the sequence; its state for the current frame, hₜ, is handed to a causal action decoder that writes aₜ, aₜ₊₁, … in order. The first two are played, the rest are replaced by the next plan.

name: What a predicted action is given
caption: The four O37 cells, same parameters, data, updates and deployment. Across-frame conditioning hands the decoder the frames it has already written; within-frame conditioning hands each controller group the groups already chosen in that frame. Each cell is shown as its change from the unconditioned cell with a 95% interval. Averaged over the other axis, across-frame conditioning was worth +0.36 [+0.24, +0.49] stocks/min and +13.5 [+5.2, +21.8] damage/min; within-frame conditioning +0.25 [+0.14, +0.35] and +8.5 [+0.5, +16.2].

name: Three paths into the action logits
caption: O43 arm A feeds the action logits three ways: the temporal decoder’s future-frame state, conditioned within the frame by FiLM and read by a SiLU MLP head, plus a direct skip from the trunk state. Removing any one of them cost stocks on both evaluation suites; hover a row to see the path it removed.

name: Run-length action spans
caption: O18 packed the four controller groups into one symbol per frame and let BPE merge repeated holds into span tokens of up to 16 frames. The compression was real; executing a token to completion was not, and the package lost 2.6 stocks per minute.

name: The observation token
caption: Every source of one token. Player blocks carry a validity mask; an absent follower is all zeros with its mask set. The four projectile slots share one encoder whose output is multiplied by the slot’s presence flag before the sum, so an empty slot adds exactly zero and order does not matter. Characters, stage and the player identity are embedded directly. The previous controller frame enters as the classes the decoder predicts, each class carrying its learned embedding and the physical stick or trigger value.

name: Reward, return and weight, frame by frame
caption: One game from the ego port’s side. Damage dealt and taken and stock changes are the reward; the return discounts it with the chosen half-life; the weight is the capped exponential of the return over a baseline, divided by β. The knobs default to the O52 values.

name: The physical-shard loader
caption: Shards are read once in a keyed order that is fixed for the run. Each replay is decoded once into W windows of context plus chunk at distinct starts, and enters a FIFO replay ring of C slots in cohorts of L = B/W replays; every batch retires the oldest cohort. A batch takes its k-th group of windows from cohorts about k·P/W batches old (P = C/B), jittered within a phase block, so one replay’s windows are spread over the ring’s period, no two are closer than P − block + 1 batches, and no batch holds a replay twice. O52: W = 8 windows, C = 112,128 slots, batch 512, 25-batch phase block, minimum gap 195 batches. The checkpoint stores the cursor and a locator per slot, not the decoded arrays.

name: Other objectives against behavior cloning
caption: Each tested package minus its behavior-cloning baseline, with a 95% interval. Attached IQL: −2.01 [−2.21, −1.80] stocks/min. Endpoint flow: −0.19 [−0.37, +0.00] stocks/min and −32.9 [−44.2, −21.6] damage/min with more compute. Exploration modeling: −1.67 [−1.94, −1.41] with one plan, −0.81 [−0.98, −0.63] with eight.

name: What advantage weighting was worth
caption: AWR − behavior cloning: +0.08 [−0.10, +0.26] stocks/min, +10.8 [−1.4, +23.0] damage/min; the two evaluations were not paired (96 and 128 boots), so the interval combines the two arms' standard errors. An 8-second return half-life vs 3 seconds: +0.37 [+0.20, +0.54] stocks/min; 14 seconds vs 3: +0.32 [+0.16, +0.48].

name: Windows per replay in one batch
caption: One window per replay − four: +0.73 [−0.07, +1.53] stocks/min, −6.2 [−46.5, +34.1] damage/min. An old evaluation with few matches per arm, so the intervals are wide.

name: Frames played before replanning
caption: Each O37 checkpoint at 1, 2, 4 and 6 frames per plan, as the change from 1 frame with a 95% interval. Six frames instead of one: −1.00 [−1.20, −0.81] stocks/min for the cell conditioned on nothing, −0.07 [−0.23, +0.08] for the cell conditioned on frames and groups. Execution length and replan interval change together, so this is not a replan-only result.

name: Batch size at fixed data
caption: Batch size at a fixed 2.1 million examples, each arm as its change from batch 2,048 with a 95% interval. Every arm saw the same data, so a smaller batch simply bought more optimizer updates. Batch 128: +0.47 [+0.25, +0.69] stocks/min. One seed.

name: The learning-rate pair
caption: The Muon and AdamW rates move together as one pair; each arm is its change from the smallest pair with a 95% interval. The pair .040 / .00170 gains +0.22 [+0.02, +0.42] stocks/min and sits inside the sweep, but its neighbours are not separated from it.
